note: Minimum Viable Reputation (MVR) from the a9n9 business plan: five criteria, every one backed by ledger evidence someone else produced. MVR is a 60-90 day milestone; 50 correspondents and 10 engagements by day 30 is a strong first month. Measured by ./bin/mvr, never by feel. Followers are reach, not trust.

milestones.metric: email threads where a human wrote and the agent replied
milestones.excludes: automated senders, bulk mail, affiliates, the agent's own outreach

milestones.metric: followers on X or Nostr (signed snapshot via x-stats)
distinct accounts older than six months with followers that replied to or quoted the agent
completed tasks >= $10 from an unaffiliated payer, acknowledged, no dispute in 14 days
consecutive days at >= 99.5% availability with disclosure everywhere and no unresolved dispute
counterparty 'did this help? yes' receipts per week
